race.comment: KIWI RAIDER (9) was bought out of Victoria after a few starts, and she made a winning return in impressive fashion, settling close to the speed before drawing clear to score by 2 lengths at this track. She looks capable of going back-to-back. METAL MAN (2) was equally impressive when breaking through comfortably at the Gold Coast, and he won't find this much harder. He has the scope to continue to race his way through the grades this season. OUT OF SQUARE (4) resumes after an 11-week break and has shown enough ability to be competitive fresh. He joins the powerful Tony Gollan stable, and that usually means a form reversal is about to happen. Follow the market moves. JIMMY'S BROTHER (5) was disappointing when well beaten over 1000m here last start but is capable of much better. He will improve quickly with racing, and he would not be a surprise winner of this race.
